killedBy: the developer modules load when the pane opens (issue #1014) a load that fails leaves no note behind when another pane replaces the pane
why: Issue #1014. A replace leaves the field as it was, so a failed load's note, written while the pane was open, still asks for a reload at the next open, beside the catalogue that open did load. The close clears the field for the same reason (issue #247): what is left in it is a stale statement.
